mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_nm, d.parent_id, d.sort_no, d.manager_user_id, d.use_yn, m.name AS manager_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_user u WHERE u.dept_id = d.dept_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn = 'Y') AS headcount FROM gw_dept d LEFT JOIN gw_user m ON m.user_id = d.manager_user_id WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(d.parent_id, 0), d.sort_no, d.dept_id

SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_nm, d.parent_id, d.sort_no, d.manager_user_id, d.use_yn, m.name AS manager_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_user u WHERE u.dept_id = d.dept_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn = 'Y') AS headcount FROM gw_dept d LEFT JOIN gw_user m ON m.user_id = d.manager_user_id WHERE d.dept_id = #{deptId}
SELECT position_id, position_nm, level_no, use_yn FROM gw_position WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY level_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_record (user_id, category_cd, title, content, event_dt) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryCd}, #{title}, #{content}, #{eventDt})
mapper.sql: r.rec_id, r.user_id, u.name AS user_name, r.category_cd, c.code_nm AS category_nm, r.title, r.content, r.event_dt, r.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_hr_record r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_RECORD_CATEGORY' AND c.code_val = r.category_cd WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.event_dt DESC NULLS LAST, r.rec_id DESC
SELECT FROM gw_hr_record r JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_RECORD_CATEGORY' AND c.code_val = r.category_cd ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_history (user_id, change_type_cd, before_json, after_json, effective_dt, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeTypeCd}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{effectiveDt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: h.his_id, h.user_id, u.name AS user_name, h.change_type_cd, c.code_nm AS change_type_nm, h.before_json, h.after_json, h.effective_dt, h.created_at, h.created_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_hr_history h JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_CHANGE_TYPE' AND c.code_val = h.change_type_cd WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.effective_dt DESC, h.his_id DESC
SELECT FROM gw_hr_history h JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_CHANGE_TYPE' AND c.code_val = h.change_type_cd WHERE h.his_id = #{hisId}

SELECT FROM gw_hr_history h JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_CHANGE_TYPE' AND c.code_val = h.change_type_cd WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.effective_dt DESC, h.his_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_family (user_id, relation_cd, name, birth_dt, dependent_yn, elderly_yn, disabled_yn) VALUES (#{userId}, #{relationCd}, #{name}, #{birthDt}, COALESCE(#{dependentYn}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{elderlyYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{disabledYn}, 'N'))
mapper.select: SELECT f.fam_id, f.user_id, u.name AS user_name, f.relation_cd, f.name, f.birth_dt, f.dependent_yn, f.elderly_yn, f.disabled_yn, f.created_at FROM gw_family f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE f.relation_cd WHEN 'SPOUSE' THEN 1 WHEN 'CHILD' THEN 2 WHEN 'PARENT' THEN 3 WHEN 'SIBLING' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END, f.birth_dt

SELECT f.fam_id, f.user_id, u.name AS user_name, f.relation_cd, f.name, f.birth_dt, f.dependent_yn, f.elderly_yn, f.disabled_yn, f.created_at FROM gw_family f JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id WHERE f.fam_id = #{famId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_career (user_id, company_nm, position_nm, start_dt, end_dt, description, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{companyNm}, #{positionNm}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{description}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT career_id, user_id, company_nm, position_nm, start_dt, end_dt, description, created_at FROM gw_hr_career WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_dt DESC NULLS LAST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_education (user_id, school_nm, major, degree_cd, edu_status_cd, admission_dt, graduation_dt, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{schoolNm}, #{major}, #{degreeCd}, #{eduStatusCd}, #{admissionDt}, #{graduationDt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT e.edu_id, e.user_id, e.school_nm, e.major, e.degree_cd, cd.code_nm AS degree_nm, e.edu_status_cd, cs.code_nm AS edu_status_nm, e.admission_dt, e.graduation_dt, e.created_at FROM gw_hr_education e LEFT JOIN gw_code cd ON cd.group_cd = 'HR_DEGREE' AND cd.code_val = e.degree_cd LEFT JOIN gw_code cs ON cs.group_cd = 'HR_EDU_STATUS' AND cs.code_val = e.edu_status_cd WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.graduation_dt DESC NULLS LAST, e.admission_dt DESC NULLS LAST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_training (user_id, course_nm, provider_nm, start_dt, end_dt, hours, cert_no, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseNm}, #{providerNm}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{hours}, #{certNo}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT trn_id, user_id, course_nm, provider_nm, start_dt, end_dt, hours, cert_no, created_at FROM gw_hr_training WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY end_dt DESC NULLS LAST, start_dt DESC NULLS LAST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_award (user_id, award_type_cd, title, occurred_on, organization, reason, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{awardTypeCd}, #{title}, #{occurredOn}, #{organization}, #{reason}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT a.award_id, a.user_id, a.award_type_cd, c.code_nm AS award_type_nm, a.title, a.occurred_on, a.organization, a.reason, a.created_at FROM gw_hr_award a LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'HR_AWARD_TYPE' AND c.code_val = a.award_type_cd WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.occurred_on DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_hr_project (user_id, project_nm, client_nm, contractor_nm, role_nm, start_dt, end_dt, tech_stack, description, kosa_grade_cd, kosa_confirmed_yn, attach_group_id, created_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectNm}, #{clientNm}, #{contractorNm}, #{roleNm}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{techStack}, #{description}, #{kosaGradeCd}, COALESCE(#{kosaConfirmedYn},'N'), #{attachGroupId}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_hr_project SET project_nm = #{projectNm}, client_nm = #{clientNm}, contractor_nm = #{contractorNm}, role_nm = #{roleNm}, start_dt = #{startDt}, end_dt = #{endDt}, tech_stack = #{techStack}, description = #{description}, kosa_grade_cd = #{kosaGradeCd}, kosa_confirmed_yn = COALESCE(#{kosaConfirmedYn}, kosa_confirmed_yn), attach_group_id = COALESCE(#{attachGroupId}, attach_group_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, c.code_nm AS kosa_grade_nm FROM gw_hr_project p LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'KOSA_GRADE' AND c.code_val = p.kosa_grade_cd WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT p.*, c.code_nm AS kosa_grade_nm FROM gw_hr_project p LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'KOSA_GRADE' AND c.code_val = p.kosa_grade_cd WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.end_dt DESC NULLS LAST, p.start_dt DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT p.*, c.code_nm AS kosa_grade_nm FROM gw_hr_project p LEFT JOIN gw_code c ON c.group_cd = 'KOSA_GRADE' AND c.code_val = p.kosa_grade_cd WHERE p.attach_group_id = #{groupId} LIMIT 1
